facts.statement: Kontext CLI is a credential broker for AI coding agents written in Go.
facts.value: Credential broker for AI coding agents in Go

facts.statement: Kontext CLI enables AI coding agents to access credentials needed for services like GitHub, Stripe, and databases without exposing long-lived API keys.
facts.value: Enable AI coding agents to access credentials securely

facts.statement: Kontext CLI runs locally and injects credentials into the AI agent's runtime environment during sessions, using OAuth and short-lived tokens.
facts.value: CLI injecting credentials at runtime for AI agents

facts.statement: The CLI streams every tool call made by the AI agent for audit as it runs, capturing what was accessed, who did it, and session context.
facts.value: Audit logs of agent tool calls with user and session attribution

facts.statement: Kontext's credential management depends on OAuth and RFC 8693 token exchange to mint short-lived, scoped credentials.
The Kontext CLI is open source and licensed under MIT, with a public repository on GitHub at kontext-security/kontext.
